verified_facts.statement: P0A defines a separate repository-local, typed, fail-closed protected-path installer contract only. It does not implement the installer, does not choose Python/runtime acquisition, does not alter Graphify builder source, does not publish a graph, and does not mutate hwm-lab, hwm-context or hwm_predictor. The one-time #87 bootstrap exception is bounded to the ten exact paths declared in ADR 0009/INFRA_SPEC §38.7 and expires permanently after #87.

decisions.decision: Introduce hwm-protected-path-install-request/bootstrap-v1 and hwm-protected-path-install-result/bootstrap-v1 as a distinct forward-only primitive rather than widen the ordinary task-branch publisher.
decisions.rationale: Recurring protected-path mutation has a stronger trust boundary than ordinary source publication and must remain separately typed, repository-local and fail-closed.

decisions.decision: Treat candidate protected workflow/action bytes as inert Git data until protected merge and source privileged installer/validator logic only from protected main.
decisions.rationale: This prevents candidate content from executing inside the privileged installation boundary or self-certifying trusted acceptance.

decisions.decision: Require exact Issue/task/repository/branch/base/head/path/blob/replace-precondition/validation bindings, expected-head CAS, byte-identical replay idempotency, changed-request-id rejection and non-mutating stale-request failure.
decisions.rationale: These bindings constrain both authority and concurrency and prevent an installation request from becoming an arbitrary Git/ref mutation channel.

decisions.decision: Authorize #87 exactly one non-reusable bootstrap transaction limited to the ten predeclared installer workflow/backend/policy/manifest/schema/test paths, protected PR/CI/merge/post-merge lifecycle and disposable live acceptance.
decisions.rationale: The installer cannot install itself before it exists, so one bounded transparent Git-object bootstrap is necessary; permanent expiry prevents it becoming a generic bypass.

decisions.decision: Abandon obsolete candidate identity 2334e79f36ccce964b090eb501e9a1072adb7eb6 and make actual regenerated INFRA_SPEC blob 53b84182af75292ca2531e0ef275292bf596d6dd the source identity.
decisions.rationale: The obsolete candidate was never a retained authoritative Git object. Owner correction explicitly replaced an impossible byte-reproduction precondition with deterministic append-only regeneration from the exact protected predecessor.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Widen hwm-publish-request/bootstrap-v1 or the ordinary publisher to accept protected .github paths.
rejected_alternatives.reason: That collapses the ordinary and privileged trust boundaries and violates the existing publisher contract.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Reuse the completed #79 publisher self-installation bootstrap exception for #85 or later protected-path work.
rejected_alternatives.reason: That exception was one-time and expired; #87 receives a separate, exact-path, non-reusable architecture-authorized bootstrap.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Use generic connector create_file/update_file/create_commit, direct push, force reset, or main mutation.
rejected_alternatives.reason: P0A source transport is restricted to inert blob creation plus the existing controlled publisher and protected PR lifecycle.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Guess or brute-force the obsolete 2334e79 candidate bytes.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Owner correction explicitly revoked that non-authoritative identity and authorized deterministic append-only regeneration from the exact predecessor.
